_comment: Enumerated request-shape typing debt, checked by `pnpm check:request-shapes`.
Every entry is a field the guard WOULD flag, kept with a reason rather than typed today.
An entry that matches nothing FAILS the check — pay the debt, delete the line.
Adding an entry is a deliberate act: prefer typing the field.

allow.GetMatchUpsArgs.publishStatus: The publish-state object's shape has never been authored — readers reach for .drawIds, .drawDetails and .displaySettings ad hoc (getDrawIsPublished.ts, getMatchUpScheduleDetails.ts:151). Typing it means inventing the shape, not recording it. Blocked on a PublishState type; see FACTORY_REQUEST_SHAPE_TYPING.md.
allow.GetDrawDataArgs.publishStatus: Same unauthored shape as GetMatchUpsArgs.publishStatus, and the same blocker.
allow.GetDrawDataArgs.status: Genuinely OPEN by design — a publish-state channel key, PUBLIC unless a provider uses a private one. The guard's registry infers from the field NAME, and `status` is polysemous across the domain (Person.status is a bare string, PracticeRegistration.status is PracticeRegistrationStatusUnion); the union it suggests here is the wrong one. This entry records a deliberate non-fix, not deferred work.
allow.GenerateDrawDefinitionArgs.qualifyingPro: Archaeology, not typing. The shape is assembled across generateEventWithDraw.ts, generateDrawStructuresAndLinks.ts and qualifyingGeneration.ts with roundTarget/structureProfiles nesting that no single site declares. Needs a reading pass before a type can be honest.
allow.ScheduledMatchUpArgs.matchUp: Reached for both MatchUp and HydratedMatchUp, and callers pass partially-assembled records mid-hydration. MatchUp | HydratedMatchUp is close but unverified against every call site.
allow.StructureProfile.stage: StageTypeUnion is the right union and this is the strongest remaining candidate. Held back only because StructureProfile is nested in drawProfiles/qualifyingProfiles across mocksEngine and generateDrawDefinition, so the break is wide; PointAward.stage (rankingTypes.ts:632) carries the same debt and should move with it.
allow.TransitionRecordStatusArgs.record: Deliberately generic — the function transitions a status on ANY record in ANY collection, keyed by collectionKey/idKey. A narrower type would defeat its purpose.
allow.CallListenerArgs.payloads: Subscription payloads are topic-shaped and provider-defined; the factory does not constrain what a subscriber receives.
allow.CallListenerArgs.notices: Deprecated back-compat alias for payloads, slated for removal in a future major. Typing a field on its way out is wasted motion.
allow.HandleCaughtErrorArgs.params: The arbitrary argument object of whichever engine method threw.
allow.HandleCaughtErrorArgs.err: A caught value. TypeScript types `catch` bindings as `unknown` or `any` by design and this is that value.
allow.AddCourtsArgs.courtTimings: Per-court timing overrides whose shape is read positionally against courtNames; unauthored, and the mocks surface is the only producer.
allow.BuildTournamentRecordArgs.eventDataDocs: Raw provider documents from an external source system. The builder's contract is that it accepts whatever the source emits.
